activities.label: Crimson Domain
activities.text: Action, with your Ketsuryugan active, once per long rest: a 40-foot radius on you for 1 minute.

rules.text: In the domain: creatures with Bleed regain half the hit points they would (you gain the rest); a creature with Bleed starting its turn there moves 30 feet or loses its Reaction until its next turn; an ally gaining hit points or temporary hit points gives half to another ally; Reaction, a creature with 2+ ranks of Bleed leaving the domain: its speed drops to 0 and it moves 15 feet toward you.

activities.label: Crimson Pact
activities.text: Over a long rest, with a willing creature you can reach: both gain the Crimson Pact (one bond at a time). Ends when dismissed, on death, or by a dispel of B-Rank or lower.

rules.text: Bonded Lifeforce: you fall to 0; your bonded creature can lose 20 maximum hit points until both of you long rest, and you fall to 20 instead.

You gain the release you didn't pick for Blood Release Affinity (set it on the sheet). Water or Medical jutsu: change the damage to necrotic when you roll. 1 minute of focus: end an Envenomed creature's (or a disease's or foreign substance's) hostile effects.

When initiative is rolled: conjure a Blade, Thrown or Flail weapon of blood, with the Critical and Blood Bound properties; you are proficient with it until initiative ends. Blood Bound: attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability; you can't be disarmed; it can stand in for a Combat Scroll for a Chakra Stance; once per turn a C-Rank or lower Bukijutsu with it can use your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu modifier. With the ammunition property, its ammunition die doesn't drop a step on a 1 or 2 (King Q-E16).
